decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-12, on the names in the titles of the Psalms that no pass answered: each word read against its title by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction that every name the Hebrew marks is read; no person has reviewed this ruling
policy: A name in a psalm's title is the man, the people or the place the title's own words say: the sons of Korah are the Levite family, Asaph is David's singer, and the occasions of David's life name the men of 1 and 2 Samuel. Where BHSA gives a title word the Strong number of a word beside it, the word is still the name it spells.
source: Essenthos, the names in the titles of the Psalms, each read against its title by claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-12
